## 7. CTAs & AUTH LINKS

- **Direct auth links**: plain `href="/login"` and `href="/register"` appear throughout marketing (header, footer, hero CTAs).
- **Plan-qualified signup**: `href={`/register?plan=${p.slug}`}` pattern found (pricing-adjacent CTAs) — carries a plan slug straight into registration.
- **Deploy-wizard prefill — the canonical mechanism**: `lib/deploy-intent.ts` exports `deployHref(intent: DeployIntent)`, building `/dashboard/deploy?<querystring>` from a `DeployIntent` object. Exact query-param mapping (`DEPLOY_PARAM`):

  | `DeployIntent` field | Query param | Example |
  |---|---|---|
  | `service` | `product` | `vps` \| `game` \| `hosting` \| `email` |
  | `planId` | `plan` | a `Plan.id` cuid |
  | `termMonths` | `term` | month count |
  | `region` | `region` | e.g. `sgp`/`de` |
  | `addons` | `addons` | comma-joined subset of `backup`/`malware`/`docker`/`ip` |
  | `diskGb` | `disk` | VPS-only extra storage |
  | `gameFamily` | `family` | e.g. `ark`, `valheim` |
  | `gamePlanId` | `tier` | a `GamePlan.id` |
  | `gameVariant` | `variant` | loader/variant key |
  | `players` | `players` | target concurrent-player count (used only when `gamePlanId` absent — maps to nearest real tier) |
  | `hostingPlanId` | `hosting` | a `HostingPlan.id` |
  | `emailPlanId` | `email` | an `EmailPlan.id` |
  | `couponCode` | `coupon` | e.g. a promo popup's code |

  This is load-bearing plumbing to preserve exactly: the same query string survives the login/signup redirect via a universal `?next=` convention (`lib/safe-next.ts`, honored by `app/login/page.tsx`, `app/register/page.tsx`, and the Google/Discord OAuth buttons in `components/AuthForms.tsx`), and `components/nx/order.tsx`'s `orderFromIntent` reads these exact same param names back out on the dashboard side. **A new marketing site MUST keep emitting these exact param names** for Deploy buttons to keep working without touching the dashboard.
- **Referral/partner links** (see §4): `/r/<code>` and `/partner/<code>` both set the `nxeon_ref` cookie and redirect to `/register`; `?ref=` query param does the same client-side via `ReferralCapture`.
- **Login/signup CTA "next" passthrough**: any marketing CTA to `/login` or `/register` that wants to return the visitor to a specific page after auth should append `?next=<path>` — already implemented site-wide, no new work needed to preserve it.

---

## 8. OLD REDESIGN ATTEMPTS

### `app/newwebsitev1` … `app/newwebsitev8`

Eight **complete, independent, self-contained homepage redesign attempts**, each a full route with its own `layout.tsx`, `page.tsx`, and scoped CSS file (`v1.css` … `v8.css`), living at the TOP level of `app/` (i.e. `/newwebsitev1` through `/newwebsitev8`, not under the `(marketing)` group). Confirmed facts:

- **All 8 are `robots: { index: false, follow: false }`** in their respective `layout.tsx` — verified by direct grep, no exceptions.
- **None are linked from anywhere else in the codebase** — a repo-wide grep for the string `newwebsitev` outside their own folders returned zero hits. They are reachable only by someone typing the exact URL.
- Each has its own supporting component files and, for v1–v4, dedicated hero art in `public/v1`–`public/v4` (aurora/globe renders). v5–v8 lean on `lib/games.ts`/`lib/nx/catalog.ts` and existing `public/games` art instead of new asset folders.
- They appear to be genuinely different design directions rather than incremental tweaks — e.g. v1 uses `HeroRotator`/`HeroAurora`, v3 has a `GameConfigurator`, v4 has a `MarketingGlobe`/`HeroGlobe`, v6 is a scroll-spine "PortalPlate" layout with a `SideIndex`, v7 has a `DeploySequence`/`PanelTour`, v8 ("Arcade") is fully DB-driven (queries `GamePlan`, `GameMod`, `Plan`, `Node` live, explicitly documented in its own file header as having "no testimonials, ratings, review widgets or player counts anywhere on this page, because the Review and Testimonial tables are empty" — the most rigorously honest of the eight).
- **Read v1's own file comment for the throughline across all of them**: "Everything quantitative on this page is real and checkable: the regions are the two Nxeon actually runs in, the entry prices are the live intro prices, the game-family count and the NxLabs catalogue size are current DB counts." This "no fabricated stats" discipline appears consistently across at least v1 and v8 — worth checking v2–v7 for the same standard before deciding which (if any) copy/approach to reuse.

### `app/(marketing)/v2`

A NINTH homepage redesign attempt, this time living inside the `(marketing)` route group at `/v2` (so it DOES render through the live `MarketingHeader`/`MarketingFooter`, unlike the `newwebsitev*` set). `export const metadata = { robots: { index: false } }` with an explicit comment "`/v2` is not the live homepage yet." Not linked from anywhere (grep for `/v2`/`'/v2'` outside its own folder returned zero hits). Uses `GlobalNetwork`, `MatrixTerminal`, `MigrationFlow`, `StatCounter` — reuses more of the existing shared marketing component library than the `newwebsitev*` set does, which built almost entirely bespoke components per attempt.

### `app/(marketing)/preview`

**Not a redesign attempt itself** — an internal gallery/index page (`robots: { index: false, follow: false }`, title "Template redesign previews") linking out to 17 sub-pages under `/preview/*`: `comparison`, `free-tier`, `game-cinematic`, `ai-hosting`, `mods`, `business-email`, `tool`, `game-editorial`, `nxcloud`, `vps`, `domains`, `location`, `web-hosting`, `app-hosting`, `blog-post`, `game-console`, `game-combined`. This is where the three superseded game-landing designs (Cinematic/Console/Editorial, §1.3) and other in-progress templates are staged for side-by-side comparison before being promoted to a live route. `/preview/game-combined` is explicitly flagged `"recommended"` in the gallery's own data — and indeed `GameLandingCombined` is what shipped live.

**Summary for the owner's decision**: 10 total abandoned/parked homepage attempts exist (8 `newwebsitev*` + `/v2` + implicitly the 3 pre-Combined game-landing designs staged under `/preview`), none indexed, none linked, all safely inspectable by direct URL today without touching the live site. They represent a genuine design-exploration archive — worth a visual pass (screenshot each) before the new marketing site is built, since some (especially v8's "no fabricated stats, everything DB-driven" approach and the Matrix/particle-field visual language) may be worth deliberately carrying forward rather than re-inventing.

---

## Open items / not fully verified in this pass

- Whether `app/page.tsx` (the live homepage) renders its own header/footer or relies on a different wrapping mechanism than `(marketing)/layout.tsx` — worth a direct read before porting.
- `components/marketing/apphostingtemplate/GhostVpsLanding.tsx` and `aihostingtemplate/{AIHostingTemplate,VibeCodingLanding}.tsx` — which of these is actually live-routed vs. preview-only wasn't fully traced.
- `components/marketing/modstemplate/ModsTemplate.tsx` appears superseded by the live `/mods` page's direct use of `StoreBrowser`/`GameCatalogueGrid` — not confirmed dead code, just unreferenced by the live route in this pass.
- Exact `GENERAL_LOCATION_SLUGS` count (~24–26) is a code-derived estimate (locations minus exclusions × 2 services), not executed/printed.
- `app/llms.txt/route.ts` contents were not read in full.
- Whether `Testimonials.tsx`/`ReviewCarousel.tsx`/`CustomerReviews.tsx` show real DB-backed data (like `ReviewBadges.tsx` does) or placeholder content was not checked — given the codebase's documented history of removing fabricated reviews/ratings once already (`CLAUDE.md` §Conventions), this is worth checking before reusing any of the three.
